'''The Broken Tusk''' was an establishment on [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. Around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Heler]] planned a metals heist against the [[Ariana Precious Metals Repository]] on [[Woostri/Legends|Woostri]] from the Lianna store.
